name: Tawheed Zubair
deck: Three Moradabad schools, two parks and 235 native and medicinal saplings. Five students in every school are Tree Monitors, and keeping them alive is their job. Eighty-eight per cent of the saplings made it.
description: Three Moradabad schools, two parks and 235 native and medicinal saplings, kept alive by five Tree Monitors per school. 88 per cent of the saplings lived.

aims.p: Fourteen of them led the sessions, the drives and the rally, on a small stipend as Youth Ambassadors rather than as volunteers on a Sunday.
Marginalised neighbourhoods carry the worst of the air and the water and get the least teaching about either. That is where the sessions went.
Five Tree Monitors per school own the watering and the checking. Survival is the deliverable here, not the planting photograph.

aims.h: Cheap enough for the next mohalla
aims.p: Posters, saplings, a rally and a stipend. Nothing in the model needs a budget the next neighbourhood cannot find.

did: Ran poster competitions, awareness sessions and plantation drives in three Moradabad schools
Planted in two parks with local youth — about forty saplings in one and seventy-two in the other
Held a youth-led awareness rally through the neighbourhood
Appointed five Tree Monitors in each school to water and check the saplings
Put fourteen Youth Ambassadors — Zaid, Ansh and Somya among them — on a small stipend to lead the sessions themselves

quotes.text: Being a part of this project for the first time made me realise that we as youth can bring about a change in our community. Not only by planting, but by also influencing others and spreading awareness.
quotes.speaker: Zaid

quotes.text: Earlier, we only knew about the environment in books, but this project made us actually work on it. Now we are taking the initiative ourselves and trying to increase the greenery around us.
quotes.speaker: Ansh

quotes.text: This initiative gave me confidence that we can make a big difference with small steps. It was a great experience to connect with people in my community and work together with them.
quotes.speaker: Somya

frames.alt: Seven young people standing at a park gate holding hand-painted posters, the middle one lettered ECONOVA, powered by Swechha
